$meta.rules: Copy is verbatim from the visible live page. Each row's h3 'Ancillary Services' kicker is rendered as a paragraph under its h2 (heading levels normalized). Learn More links carry visually hidden context ('about <service>').
liveSiteIssuesFound: Sibling chip 'Litigous Scrub' is misspelled on every ancillary page; fixed to 'Litigious Scrub' (the page itself is titled Litigious Scrub).

Renkim Reporting row: Learn More links https://renkim.com/ancillary-services/renkim-reporting/, which redirects to the homepage. The redesign links https://renkim.com/portal/renkim-reporting/ (the Portal page the hero chip already uses).
The rendered HTML outline is missing the Bankruptcy & Deceased and Email Verification descriptions, but both are visible on the live page; the redesign uses the visible text.

rows.heading: Address Element Correction (AEC)
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Renkim’s Address Element Correction service ensures that your mailing addresses are accurate and up-to-date, reducing the risk of undeliverable mail, and improving delivery efficiency.

rows.heading: Bankruptcy & Deceased
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Our Bankruptcy & Deceased service manages sensitive data related to bankruptcy and deceased accounts, ensuring compliance and accuracy in your communications.

rows.heading: Email Verification
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Renkim’s Email Verification service validates email addresses to improve delivery rates and communication accuracy, helping you reach your audience more effectively.

rows.heading: Litigious Scrub
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Reduce legal risks by using Renkim’s Litigious Scrub service to identify potentially litigious consumers before initiating contact.

rows.heading: Lockbox
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Our Lockbox service provides secure and efficient payment processing, managing your receivables with accuracy and reliability.

rows.heading: Phone Search
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Enhance your contact information with Renkim’s Phone Search service, which provides accurate and up-to-date phone number data.

rows.heading: Renkim 360
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Renkim 360 offers comprehensive data management solutions, integrating various services to provide a full-circle approach to your business needs.

rows.heading: Return Mail Processing
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Renkim’s Return Mail Processing service efficiently handles returned mail, keeping your records current, and reducing wasted resources.

rows.heading: USPS CASS, DPV, NCOA
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Our USPS CASS, DPV, and NCOA services ensure compliance with USPS standards for address accuracy, improving the deliverability of your mail.

rows.heading: Vacant Address Search
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Identify vacant addresses with Renkim’s Vacant Address Search service to avoid undeliverable mail and enhance your mailing efficiency.

rows.heading: Renkim Reporting
rows.kickerLive: h3 "Ancillary Services" (rendered as a kicker paragraph)
rows.body: Renkim Reporting provides detailed reports to track and analyze your operations, offering insights to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
